name: std::function<R(Args...)>::operator()
intro:
Invokes the stored callable function target with the parameters args.

Effectively does INVOKE<R>(f, std::forward<Args>(args)...), where f is the target object of *this.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
args

 -

 parameters to pass to the stored callable function target

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: None if R is void. Otherwise the return value of the invocation of the stored callable object.

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text: Throws std::bad_function_call if *this does not store a callable function target, i.e. !*this == true.

summary: Invokes the stored callable function target with the parameters args.
